svg.text: भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् । सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्
bhoktāraṁ yajña-tapasāṁ sarva-loka-maheśvaram / suhṛdaṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ jñātvā māṁ śāntim ṛ
Knowing the Lord as the enjoyer of sacrifice and austerity, the proprietor of all worlds, and the friend of all beings —
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
